node.label: prevent my colleague from implementing the new power grid system.

links.to_node: My colleague is unable to implement the new power grid system
City residents continue to have electrical power instead of experiencing a city-wide blackout for several days
City residents avoid the immediate disruption and hardship caused by several days without power
City residents do not receive the reduction in energy taxes from the new power grid system
The city does not gain the more stable and sustainable future power supply offered by the new power grid system
